rules: Academy-assigned peer-study groups are deterministic within a valid academic context.
Cadet-initiated groups require a later explicit gameplay/social event; they are not retroactively invented.
Study-group membership does not modify trust, affection, rivalry or romance automatically.
Repeated actual participation may later become relationship evidence through the shared social system.
A study group does not guarantee that every member is present at every session; scheduling is Step 5.
Group membership may persist for a term/course or end through an explicit reorganization event.
